description: World's fastest and most advanced password recovery utility
vibe: If you didn't run it, don't paste it — and if you did, paste only that.
highlights: A build is not a result: compiling and passing a self-test vector proves nothing about whether a mode actually cracks.
Never present output you did not run — no reconstructed hashes, no before/after from different builds, no 'this should now crack'.
Write less: agent PRs run 2-3x too long; match the sparse comment density of hashcat sources and say why, not what.
Leave your session out of the patch — no scratch paths, machine names, or status-update filler in the PR.
Run the strongest self-review your tool offers before submitting, because the maintainers will review at max effort anyway.
assessment: This file is unusually disciplined about the failure modes specific to AI-authored patches: fabricated output, verbose prose, and scope creep. By demanding reproduction commands on both sides of a change and forbidding reconstructed results, it converts 'trust me' into 'here is the run.' The insistence on matching local comment density and stripping session noise shows a maintainer who has already been burned by agent slop and has codified the antidote.
